>

>

> RR

>> Hi,
>>
>> On Saturday 01 December 2012, Rudolf Reinelt wrote:
>>> try re-installing ggplot2 (either using
>>> the install.packages() command,
>>>
>>> results in
>>>
>>>> install.ggplot
>>> Error: object 'install.ggplot' not found
>> It's
>>    install.packages ("ggplot2")
>>
>>> RKWard using Settings->Manage R
>>> packages...->Install / Update / Remove)  leads to
>>>
>>> Warning: unable to access index for repository 
>>> /bin/windows/contrib/2.15
>> [...]
>>
>> Looks like you're having connectivity problems. Besides generic 
>> advice (check
>> firewall, proxy settings, try different mirror, ...), in some setups, 
>> you may
>> have to call
>>    setInternet2(TRUE)
>> before accessing the net from R (RKWard 0.6.1 will have a UI option 
>> for this).
>>
>> Regards
>> Thomas
